projects.name: Sheetz Constellation Offsite Renewables (CORe) agreement
projects.quote: On Feb. 16, 2022, and March 31, 2022, we announced agreements with Sheetz and Comcast, respectively, to purchase power and renewable energy certificates (RECs) to help avoid carbon emissions and meet their individual carbon goals.
